fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/ekalaka-park-campground (Fee Site and Info: 'No fees are required for this site'; last updated May 4, 2026), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/ekalaka-park-campground ('Ekalaka Park Campground does not offer reservations through Recreation.gov ... it is managed on a first-come, first-served basis. There is a 16 day stay limit.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: FS: 'Seasons of Use: All Year. Weather Dependent.'
6 sites plus 1 group site and 2 day-use picnic sites (the description says 'Campground with 7 sites'). Open parking; FS: 'Small trailers only.'

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/ekalaka-park-campground ('Camp Sites: 6 sites, 1 group site, and 2-day use picnic sites'; Parking 'Open parking. Small trailers only.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: No trash pickup, no firewood. A spring with non-potable water is nearby. The FS page lists an accessible toilet but also says 'Restrooms are not available at this site.'

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/ekalaka-park-campground ('Potable water is not available at this site. A spring with non-potable water is nearby.'; 'Trash Pickup: No', 'Firewood: No'; Accessible Facilities 'Toilet'; 'Restrooms are not available at this site.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Custer Gallatin NF (Sioux District, Ekalaka Hills Unit) campground among ponderosa pine with cliff-edge views over the prairie. From Ekalaka 3 mi SE on MT-323, then about 6 mi on FR 3813 (Stagville Rd) straight through the 4-way intersection to the road's end. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the FS page (updated May 2026): free, FCFS only, 16-day limit, 6 sites + 1 group site. Added year-round season (weather dependent), no potable water. Not stated: max rig length beyond 'small trailers only', hookups. Note corrected (the campground is ~9 mi from Ekalaka, not ~3) and trimmed of restated values and the Campendium length claim.
flags: Criteria: the FS page says 'Parking: Open parking. Small trailers only.' (no length given); the note's 'sites to ~30 ft' came from Campendium. Whether a 23-ft motorhome fits is unconfirmed.
Missing phone: Sioux District Office (605) 797-4432 (FS page Contact Information).
Toilets unclear: the FS page lists an accessible toilet and also says restrooms are not available; vault_toilets left unset.
